Reading for P01: this is the tenth looped/stacked variant below its incumbent (014, 028, 089, 105, 106, 125-fable, 132-fable, 134-fable, 138-fable, now stacking as init), and it closes the 'loop as free init, spend the saving on steps' route too, because there is nothing to spend the saved steps on at this data budget; a further stacking test would have to grow earlier (e.g. 15%) to give the untied blocks most of the run, which is a schedule nudge rather than a new mechanism.
